svg.title: Plot 97
svg.desc: Line chart of activity against hour, with scatter plot of activity against hour, in polar coordinates. angle from 0 to 24, radius from 0 to 3. 9 rows.

svg.style: --axis-line: #727272; --axis-halo: #ffffff; font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(37, 37, 37); fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;

text.style: font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; fill: rgb(37, 37, 37); stroke: rgb(255, 255, 255); stroke-width: 3px; paint-order: stroke; color: rgb(37, 37, 37); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: round;
